name: Neither
tagline: Self-filling recruiting system for small agencies on Google Workspace. People decide. AI does the heavy lifting.
description: Neither is a self-filling recruiting system for 3–15-person agencies on Google Workspace: candidate records build themselves from CVs, documents, emails and calls, each fact sourced. It scores every applicant against every open role as a first read, chases missing details by email, schedules interviews from Google Calendar, files your Meet, Zoom and Teams calls with timestamped quotes, and sends hiring managers briefs they open without an account. Try it free: paste a job ad and get an interview scorecard in about 30 seconds, no sign-up. People decide. AI does the heavy lifting. Try the recruitment module.
